title: TestPlan
description: What must be checked, stated without reference to any language. The framework derives this from a model (diagram-as-oracle, spec §6.3); a per-stack emitter turns it into idiomatic tests. Emitters render, they never decide: nothing about which checks exist, or what each asserts, is an emitter's judgment.

shim_registered.description: Whether the application has registered a subject shim for this model (spec §6.3). False means the suite cannot execute: an emitter must render it unrunnable — ignored-with-reason, or the stack's equivalent — because a suite that cannot execute must not look like one that passed.

model_hash.description: The model's content hash when the plan was derived. A suite generated from a stale plan is red by §6.3 — green against a stale model is red.

verified_by.description: Active RUs whose verification cites this model. Generated suites carry no per-test annotations; their traceability is inherited through this list (formats §5).

checks.description: In emission order. Every check is one assertion: a declared transition, a rejection of an undeclared state/event pair, or an invariant probe.

id.description: Stable, language-neutral check identity. Emitters map it to an idiomatic test name; the mapping must be deterministic so traceability survives regeneration.
